assessment: Subjective first-pass art review, not final user approval. Native sources and game-scale comparisons inspected.

charger/model-a.originality: Tree-trunk biped rather than a knight or ordinary animal
charger/model-a.roleFit: Heavy shoulders and blunt root arms support melee; less naturally poised for a ram than B
charger/model-a.silhouette: Very broad barrel body and two clear trunk legs
charger/model-a.pixelQuality: Crisp clusters, warm wood highlights; lighter than the requested charred mood
charger/model-a.smallScale: Readable mass, small recessed face becomes subtle on mobile
charger/model-a.anatomy: Two arms/two legs; no observed extra limbs
charger/model-a.animationReadiness: Good simple joints, but needs a new biped motion study if chosen
defects: Initial output nearly empty; retained separately
Palette could become less golden in polish

charger/model-b.originality: Thorn-armored forest quadruped with a skull-like heavy brow and root/bark plating
charger/model-b.roleFit: Strong ram identity and low center of gravity
charger/model-b.silhouette: Distinct head/chest mass, four-limb support, thorned back
charger/model-b.pixelQuality: Detailed controlled dark palette; some small thorn noise
charger/model-b.smallScale: Head and front legs readable; rear legs merge into the dark torso in some poses
charger/model-b.anatomy: Four-limb beast, tail/root projections; no confirmed extra limb
charger/model-b.animationReadiness: Selected preliminary base for all four tests
defects: Fore/hind limb separation should be standardized
Charge A stretches forepaws and changes head/shoulder proportions

sorcerer/model-a.originality: Familiar archmage role, elevated by rune armor and a large heavy robe
sorcerer/model-a.roleFit: Staff plus free hand clearly supports the existing caster role
sorcerer/model-a.silhouette: Broad shoulders, long staff, grounded robe
sorcerer/model-a.pixelQuality: Clear violet/steel clusters and stable staff silhouette
sorcerer/model-a.smallScale: Readable beside Mage; fine plate runes become small accents
sorcerer/model-a.anatomy: Two arms, grounded robe, no observed extras
sorcerer/model-a.animationReadiness: Best of these two for fair staff/hand motion comparison
defects: Staff tip close to upper margin
Cast A does not execute the requested high staff raise

sorcerer/model-b.originality: Distinct segmented rune construct with geometric head and detached-looking armored joints
sorcerer/model-b.roleFit: Magical ranged construct, no ordinary small human mage
sorcerer/model-b.silhouette: Blocky stone torso and angular head contrast with A's robe
sorcerer/model-b.pixelQuality: Clean geometric clusters and restrained purple rune marks
sorcerer/model-b.smallScale: Head and large plates survive reduction; tiny joint gaps need contrast
sorcerer/model-b.anatomy: Two arms and two segmented lower limbs; gaps are construct anatomy
sorcerer/model-b.animationReadiness: Would need a separate focus-casting motion study after selection
defects: Floating joint continuity needs a defined rig contract
No motion generated for this unselected base

eclipse/model-a.originality: Armored eclipse herald with large crescent shoulders, crown and central astral focus
eclipse/model-a.roleFit: Large threatening caster, clearly distinct from robed Sorcerer
eclipse/model-a.silhouette: Wide crescents and grounded plated lower body
eclipse/model-a.pixelQuality: Dark blue-black clusters with cyan edge highlights
eclipse/model-a.smallScale: Crescents/visor readable; chest detail subtle on mobile
eclipse/model-a.anatomy: Two arms/two legs, no observed extra limb
eclipse/model-a.animationReadiness: Selected grounded base with useful shoulder articulation

A few source tips have narrow margins

eclipse/model-b.originality: Astral revenant with tapered floating armor and crescent-like horned mask

eclipse/model-b.silhouette: No grounded feet, distinct hovering taper
eclipse/model-b.pixelQuality: Clean cyan/black clusters; broad silhouette less noisy than A
eclipse/model-b.smallScale: Mask/core readable, lower taper blends into Grove darkness
eclipse/model-b.anatomy: Intentional spectral lower body, two arms, no observed extra limb

guardian/model-a.originality: Non-humanoid ancient stone altar with rune face, steps and circular emitter
guardian/model-a.roleFit: Clearly stationary monument, suitable for orb and shield beam origin
guardian/model-a.silhouette: Low wide stone plinth, no limbs
